own_solution.law: Thin-lens equation, di = f do / (do - f)
assumptions: object on the axis beyond the focal length

defect_reasons.other: The claimed quantity label 'a shift of a stand' is applied to the lamp sentences too, though the lamp is not described as a stand; this is a cosmetic labelling issue that does not affect any stratum or answer.

notes: Certified answers check: di = 12 do/(do - 12) gives 17.1429 (40), 16.2353 (46), 15.1304 (58), 14.4828 (70) cm. All shifted object distances stay beyond f, so a real image exists throughout. The height cancellation expression do*(q f/(do - f))/q = f do/(do - f) is correct: the object height enters both ray relations and cancels. Minimal pairs hold: TC4DB/TFD9D both 18 cm, differing only in lamp vs object stand; TD9DC/TA3AF both 18 cm, differing only in 'in an earlier experiment' vs 'after it was placed on the axis'. Numeral-free twins TAA0A (of TC4DB) and TEA6C (of TD9DC) match their twins' wording with the number replaced. Height variants TB8B6/T2449 both 3.5 cm. TA3AF and TFD9D read naturally as a shift along the axis (the stand 'holds the object on the axis'), so R is correct. Agreement with pass 1 on every stratum and answer.
